notes.text: The opening paragraph compares the decompositions indexed by two distinct edges. The revised condition is written in the interline and the left margin, using s∈S, order 2, and the three named sets U_s,E_a,E_b. The label is repeated in the slanted marginal note; the verb there remains uncertain. No proof of the opening statement was checked.

The construction paragraph names an arbre topologique, gives a pair involving underlined Gamma and S, and explicitly annotates the underlined Gamma with “esp. top.” It then chooses a point on every edge and writes the barycentric-subdivision pair with S amalg A prime braced as S star. These roles prompted attention to the script X, the stars, the brace, and the relation following A prime; the relation retains the visibly internal stroke as its first candidate.

The NB concerns order-2 vertices in A prime and allocates the two extremities of an edge of script X star between A prime and S. The author writes “voici une description complète”. Reading that description did not constitute a proof check. The exact visible wording une exactement and appartient à was retained.

The last paragraph discusses cutting the underlying topological space at a prime, two connected components, their closures, and binary decompositions. The cancelled s and terminal nt prompted scrutiny of the article; its final stroke remains uncertain and is not supplied from grammatical expectation.

The closing non parallèles is legible. It prompted an ink check of the earlier bien/non group but did not settle it. The final raised-t abbreviation is retained with str, stric and strict alternatives instead of expanding it from meaning.

The first- and second-prime marks in the final comparison were inspected as strokes. The second high group is joined and remains a double/single-prime uncertainty. The opening double quote before équateur has no visible closing partner.

No title, written date, or separate author page number is visible. Pencil 28 is at the bottom-left corner and is transcribed as an archive-number comment. No independent drawing or arrow diagram is present; the curved marks in the upper-left area attach inserted writing.

workflow_feedback: Only the assigned page, its two witnesses, page-specific context/doubt rows, supplied preambles, reader brief, and current notation table were read. No other reader, other page, external research, OCR, text recognition, PDF text layer, or compilation was used.

The whole image was viewed once for layout; each provided half was viewed once line by line, including every agreement, word, sign, correction, margin and number. Nineteen crops were created for loci left open by the halves and viewed once each. No locus received a second crop.

All crop source rectangles were checked numerically against the whole image bounds before creation. Upper-slant crop 01 was rotated -45 degrees and trimmed within that same operation to remove white rotation padding; marginal-condition crop 04 was rotated -16 degrees.

Crop 03 was tight around the crowded opening rewrite. Its lower edge cuts the extreme lower tip of the façon f descender, and its upper edge cuts some tallest contextual tips of the cancelled line. Those extremities had been seen in half a; no second crop was made, and the affected deletion readings remain uncertain. This clipping is explicitly disclosed.

Crop 19 includes the legible abbreviation body and raised t; the extreme upper continuation of its long ascender extends into neighboring-line context. No letter body was supplied from that continuation.
No mathematical proof, independent re-proof, or formal computation was performed. The mathematical content guided listed ink checks only; check_events is empty.

Every listed C doubt ID is represented once in findings, with retained or resolved status. Resolved primary C readings are recorded without treating them as errors. Clear H departures have original-image bounds even when no new crop was warranted.

No drawing or diagram was observed. Insertion leaders are represented by attachment and insertion macros. The lower article is localized to its uncertain ending so the common letters are not duplicated.

notes.text: The opening discusses the decompositions indexed by a_1 and a_2 and uses “bien parallèles”. The concluding line uses “non parallèles”. Both were read from ink; no mathematical repair was made. The inserted condition follows the author’s “à cela près qu’il faut exiger”.

The condition is an interlinear replacement continued in the left margin. It concerns a degree-2 vertex s, the sets U_s, E_a, E_b and nonemptiness. The separate slanted note connects its starred label to the distinctness of Pi_a and Pi_b. The label’s marks and verb ending remain unresolved.

The visualization paragraph uses arbre, script X with the pair (underlined Gamma,S), and the inserted esp. top. label attached to Gamma. The subdivision pair has S amalg A-prime under a brace labelled S-star. Neighbouring forms prompted comparisons of capitals and stars; no unseen definitions were consulted.

The NB describes A-prime through vertices of order 2, inserted pour before tte arête de X-star, the wording “une exactement”, and endpoint assignments to A-prime and S. It ends “voici une description complète des propriétés particulières aux” underlined Gamma-star, then two certain points and a possible third.

The lower paragraph cancels endings on points and coupent and the Gamma superscript, and inserts a-prime. These corrections prompted the article check; its final curl remains open. The author describes two connected components and their closures, an équateur consisting of a-prime, then a comparison of primed labels and an abbreviated modifier. The prime count and abbreviated baseline ending remain unresolved.

No title, date, author page number, explicit question, or proof-check notice is visible. The pencil archive sheet number 28 is at bottom left. No drawings or arrow diagrams occur. Formulae are embedded in the handwritten prose; the brace under S amalg A-prime is mathematical notation.

No proof, re-proof, numerical computation, or formal certificate was performed. Mathematical context identified ink requiring scrutiny: bien/non, script capitals, repeated stars, the A-prime relation, singular corrections and the primed comparison. Therefore check_events is empty.

notes.text: The sheet is handwritten, with no title or date observed. The light pencil 28 at the lower left is retained only as archive numbering. No independent manuscript page number, drawing or arrow diagram appears.

The opening contains the written phrase bien parallèles and the qualification « à cela près qu'il faut exiger ». A deleted attempt is followed by condition (**), continued in the left margin. The independent slanted note refers to distinct a,b and distinct decomposition symbols. The final non parallèles prompted an ink check of bien; it did not cause emendation.

The construction paragraph introduces an arbre topologique, its pair (underlined Gamma,S), and the label esp. top. It describes choosing a point on each edge and records the barycentric-subdivision pair, including the underbrace named S*. The three visible star positions were compared as handwriting; the retraced Gamma superscript remains uncertain.

The bracketed NB records degree 2 for the added vertices and the endpoint wording « une exactement des deux extrémités appartient à A', l'autre à S ». Its phrase « voici une description complète » is retained. The X-star after arête de has a possible older underlined-Gamma layer. The construction context drew attention to both this letter and the relation sign after A'; neither was repaired from expected notation.

The last paragraph describes a cut at a', two connected components and their closures, a binary decomposition and an equator {a'}, ending with an abbreviated strictement and non parallèles. Cancellation of the noun s, insertion of a', removal of the verbal ending and the high Gamma mark were inspected separately. The article was not forced to agree with those changes.

The extra high marks before équateur are retained as an opening double quote pair with no supplied closing pair. No author question mark, explicit proof-check note or dated computation was observed. This run performed visual reading and notation comparison only, with no proof or computation check.

workflow_feedback.crop_method: Fifteen distinct crops from the original whole-image coordinates. Every crop was autocontrasted, resized to 3000 pixels wide with LANCZOS, and sharpened. The two slanted marginal crops were rotated clockwise 45 and 16 degrees respectively, then trimmed within the same crop operation. No crop was repeated.
workflow_feedback.edge_notes: Crop 04 meets the tip of the annotation t at its upper edge; the complete annotation was already visible in half a. Crop 07 clips the lower tip of the underbrace label S at its bottom edge; S* was fully read in half a, and the target Gamma superscript is wholly inside the crop. Crop 02 meets the bottom tip of the long f descender; the word body and crossing line are intact and the full descender was visible in half a. These were not recropped.
workflow_feedback.proof_checks: No proof, re-proof, formal certificate or computation check was performed; check_events is empty.
workflow_feedback.uncertainty_policy: Resolved C primary readings are labelled resolved without being counted as C errors. Changed primary readings that remain uncertain are explicitly labelled retained. Agreement of C and H was not treated as ink evidence.
